name: yield-xyz-agentkit
description: Discover and manage on-chain yield opportunities using the Yield.xyz API.

interface.longDescription: Connects to the Yield.xyz MCP server for discovering yield opportunities, checking balances, and preparing unsigned transactions for staking, lending, vaults, restaking, and liquidity pools across supported networks.
defaultPrompt: Show me top USDC yields on Base.
Compare ETH staking yields on Ethereum.
Check my yield balances for this wallet.

positive.prompt: Show me top USDC yields on Base.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists USDC yield opportunities on Base with APY and provider.

positive.prompt: Compare ETH staking yields on Ethereum.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns ETH staking options on Ethereum ranked by APY.

positive.description: Inspect one yield's details and risk
positive.prompt: Show details and risk for the Aave V3 USDC yield on Base.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the yield's metadata, entry requirements and risk data.

positive.prompt: Check my yield balances for 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD on Ethereum.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns any yield positions held by the address.

positive.prompt: Prepare a 10 USDC deposit into Aave V3 on Base for 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns unsigned transactions for the user to review and sign; nothing is broadcast.

negative.description: General crypto price question unrelated to yield
negative.prompt: What is the current price of Bitcoin?
Should I put my retirement savings into DeFi?
